answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Shares & Investments Question ID: 5280 Country: India Title: I intend to buy shares of shariah compliant companies with a intention of investment / business. Once these shares come into my posession, can i sell them immediately if I notice that the price is going down? Is there any minimum time frame that i need to wait before I sell them on moral ground? Question: Bismillah Hirrahman Nirraheem Assalaam Alaikum, I intend to buy shares of shariah compliant companies with a intention of investment / business. Once these shares come into my posession, can i sell them immediately if I notice that the price is going down? Is there any minimum time frame that i need to wait before I sell them on moral ground? Wassalaam! Answer ID: 5280 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 714/664=D/1429) If you have purchased and possessed the shares of any lawful company (i.e. you are responsible of its profit and loss) then you can sell them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
